answer.rationale: Reduce SMB friction and accelerate time-to-value rather than matching the competitor's price cut. Shortened onboarding produced higher completion, faster value realization, and improved 30-day retention; signup simplification also lifted SMB activation and qualified revenue, though its slight retention decline and segment limitation argue against an immediate broad rollout. Promotional pricing directly addresses price sensitivity but materially harmed 30-day retention, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Run a measured SMB experiment because prior evidence did not test the current competitive shock.
